# Play & Plan Paper

> Printable party games and planners from a small shop in Manchester, England. Every product is an instant PDF download in A4 and US Letter, with full-colour and ink-saver versions, sold through our Etsy shop.

Key facts:
- Shop: https://playandplanpaper.etsy.com/ (Etsy handles payment and the instant download; nothing is posted)
- Sizes: A4 (UK spellings) and US Letter (US spellings); ink-saver version of every page
- Licence: personal use, print as many copies as your own household, party or classroom needs
- Best value Christmas pack: Ultimate Christmas Games Bundle (30+ games): https://playandplanpaper.com/p/ultimate-christmas-games-bundle/

## Guides (free game ideas, answers and printable tips)
- [40 Christmas cracker jokes for kids and adults (clean and groan-worthy)](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/christmas-cracker-jokes/): The best Christmas cracker jokes are short puns that everyone can get, like "What do you call Santa when he stops moving? Santa Pause." Below are 40 clean ones: 20 for kids and 20 groaners for adults, ready to read out or slip into homemade crackers.
- [40 Christmas quiz questions and answers for families](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/christmas-quiz-questions-and-answers/): Here are 40 family-friendly Christmas quiz questions with answers, in four rounds of ten: films and TV, music, food and traditions, and general knowledge. Play in teams, read one round between courses, and give a point per correct answer.
- [12 office Christmas party games and ideas your team will actually enjoy](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/office-christmas-party-games/): The best office Christmas party games are easy, quick and include everyone: office party bingo, funny staff awards, a work Christmas quiz, Find a Colleague and Secret Santa. Print them ahead and each one takes 10 to 20 minutes to run.
- [10 games to play at the Christmas dinner table](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/christmas-dinner-table-games/): The best Christmas dinner table games need no moving and no mess: Christmas dinner bingo, table talk question cards, a cracker joke-off, Would You Rather and a quick 20-question quiz. Each takes 5 to 15 minutes and works for any age.
- [How to play the Left Right Christmas game (with a free short story)](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/left-right-christmas-game/): To play the Left Right Christmas game, everyone sits in a circle holding a wrapped gift. One person reads a story aloud, and every time they say "left" or "right", everyone passes their gift that way. When the story ends, you keep the gift you're holding.
- [25 Secret Santa questions to ask your coworkers](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/secret-santa-questions-for-coworkers/): Good Secret Santa questions cover favourite snacks and drinks, hobbies, allergies and anything someone definitely doesn't want. Ask 5 to 10 questions on a sign-up sheet, set a budget, and share the answers only with each person's Secret Santa.
- [What to put in a Christmas Eve box: ideas for kids, teens and adults](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/what-to-put-in-a-christmas-eve-box/): A classic Christmas Eve box holds new pyjamas, hot chocolate and a mug, a Christmas film or book, a snack for Santa, reindeer food and a letter from Santa. Add a small activity for kids, or swap in grown-up treats for adults.
- [15 Christmas scavenger hunt clues for kids (rhyming, indoor)](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/christmas-scavenger-hunt-clues-for-kids/): A Christmas scavenger hunt for kids uses rhyming clues hidden around the house, each one leading to the next, with a treat at the end. Below are 15 indoor clues with their hiding places. Pick 8 to 12 for a hunt that takes about 20 minutes.
- [12 printable Christmas games for adults that get everyone laughing](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/printable-christmas-games-for-adults/): The best printable Christmas games for adults are Who's Most Likely To, Would You Rather, the Left Right gift game and charades. They need nothing but a printer, work for 4 to 20 people and take 10 to 30 minutes each.
- [8 printable Christmas games and activities for kids](https://playandplanpaper.com/ideas/christmas-games-for-kids/): Great printable Christmas games for kids are a rhyming scavenger hunt, picture bingo, charades and a letter to Santa. Picture-based games suit children who can't read yet, and clue hunts work best from about age 6.
